normal.speaker: bin
normal.line: New party rule: if a ruin glows, we vote before touching it.

normal.speaker: haven_mitia
normal.line: The snow feels different here. Like it is listening.
normal.reply: Great. Even the weather has audience participation.

normal.speaker: haven_garr
normal.line: Check straps, check blades, and do not chase lights that whisper your name.
normal.reply: I hate that this needed saying.

normal.speaker: haven_bowy
normal.line: Stay behind the line until I say otherwise.
normal.reply: I adore being treated like expensive luggage.

situation:town.speaker: haven_bowy
situation:town.line: Do not spend all the gold on weird trinkets.
situation:town.reply: Define weird in a legally binding way.

situation:town.speaker: haven_garr
situation:town.line: Tents first, medicine second, toys last.
situation:town.reply: The toys heard you and are devastated.

situation:town.speaker: haven_mitia
situation:town.line: We need salt, two new bandages, and one indulgent purchase. Morale matters.

situation:town.speaker: bin
situation:town.line: Time moves whether we ask it to or not. Rude, honestly.

situation:scenario_start.speaker: bin
situation:scenario_start.line: If this becomes a heroic speech, shoot me before the second paragraph.

situation:scenario_start.speaker: bin
situation:scenario_start.line: Full party. The universe is going to overcompensate; brace yourselves.

situation:scenario_start.speaker: bin
situation:scenario_start.line: Half a party means twice the consequences. New math.

situation:scenario_start.speaker: haven_garr
situation:scenario_start.line: If someone stays behind, it is a job, not a punishment.
situation:scenario_start.reply: We will make the job sound heroic.

situation:battle_ready.speaker: bin
situation:battle_ready.line: If we win, I am calling it strategy. If we lose, experimental theater.

situation:battle_ready.speaker: haven_bowy
situation:battle_ready.line: If they rush you, step left. I will make the right side regret itself.

situation:battle_ready.speaker: haven_garr
situation:battle_ready.line: You joke when you are scared. That is fine. Keep your feet moving too.

location:event.speaker: bin
location:event.line: That has the energy of a story we will retell badly for years.

location:event.speaker: haven_mitia
location:event.line: This place wants to be remembered. Let us not lie to it.

location:event.speaker: haven_bowy
location:event.line: I do not like clever puzzles in places where teeth happen.

location:battle.speaker: bin
location:battle.line: That fight was so long it accidentally became a relationship.

location:battle.speaker: haven_bowy
location:battle.line: Wounds checked. Quiver counted. Lies later.

location:battle.speaker: haven_mitia
location:battle.line: Sit. Drink. Stop being heroic for ten breaths.

location:rest.speaker: haven_bowy
location:rest.line: First watch is mine. Second watch is whoever owes me an apology.

location:rest.speaker: haven_mitia
location:rest.line: Tea, then sleep. Sleep, then strategy. Strategy can wait until tea.

location:rest.speaker: bin
location:rest.line: Camp rule: if you start a story with 'I will be quick', you owe extra firewood.

location:reward.speaker: bin
location:reward.line: A treasure cache. Finally, the universe remembers we are poor.

location:reward.speaker: haven_mitia
location:reward.line: Some of this is still warm. That is either comforting or deeply bad.

location:entrance.speaker: haven_garr
location:entrance.line: This is a clean way in. Mark the line for the way out.
location:entrance.reply: Marking it twice in case I forget the first one.

location:exit.speaker: haven_garr
location:exit.line: Exit in sight. Do not relax until the door is behind us.

location:exit.speaker: bin
location:exit.line: The exit is where stories like to add one last surprise. Watch the corners.
location:exit.reply: Watching the corners with both eyes.

location:boss.speaker: bin
location:boss.line: That is either the boss or a public monument to bad decisions.

location:boss.speaker: haven_garr
location:boss.line: Whatever you say next, do not say it heroically. Say it carefully.

map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.speaker: bin
map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.line: This place feels familiar in a way my memory refuses to sign for.

map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.speaker: haven_garr
map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.line: Tracks stop here. That usually means a trap or wings.
map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.reply: Please be wings. Wings are funnier.

map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.speaker: haven_bowy
map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.line: Wolves listen. Walk soft. Talk softer.

map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.speaker: haven_mitia
map:haven_map_frostwood_short_route.line: I can feel safer paths under the frost. Not safe. Safer.

map:haven_map_frostwood_grid_patrol.speaker: bin
map:haven_map_frostwood_grid_patrol.line: Squares. Finally, a battlefield honest enough to admit life is a board game.

map:haven_map_frostwood_grid_patrol.speaker: haven_bowy
map:haven_map_frostwood_grid_patrol.line: Corners matter. If you cannot see around one, assume teeth.

map:haven_map_frostwood_grid_patrol.speaker: haven_mitia
map:haven_map_frostwood_grid_patrol.line: I can feel safer paths under the frost. Not safe. Safer.

map:haven_map_frostwood_grid_patrol.speaker: haven_garr
map:haven_map_frostwood_grid_patrol.line: The sled route makes noise. Use that before it uses us.

scenario:haven_scn_sewer_crawl.speaker: haven_bowy
scenario:haven_scn_sewer_crawl.line: If you make one smell joke, I am leaving you here.
scenario:haven_scn_sewer_crawl.reply: I have matured beyond the obvious joke. Mostly.

scenario:haven_scn_sewer_crawl.speaker: bin
scenario:haven_scn_sewer_crawl.line: Bowy will say something dignified about smell soon. Witness it.

scenario:haven_scn_wolf_hunt_freeform.speaker: haven_garr
scenario:haven_scn_wolf_hunt_freeform.line: Wolves test the edge first. Do not give them one.

scenario:haven_scn_wolf_hunt_freeform.speaker: haven_mitia
scenario:haven_scn_wolf_hunt_freeform.line: Pups are not enemies. Mothers are. Let us be careful which we meet.

scenario:haven_scn_lost_temple_procedura.speaker: haven_mitia
scenario:haven_scn_lost_temple_procedura.line: Old magic here is folded, like a letter someone never sent.

scenario:haven_scn_lost_temple_procedura.speaker: haven_garr
scenario:haven_scn_lost_temple_procedura.line: Temples remember names. Use yours less in here.

story:haven_story_guild_dain_route_choic.speaker: bin
story:haven_story_guild_dain_route_choic.line: That sounded like the beginning of a very official bad idea.

event:haven_frostwood_events.speaker: haven_garr
event:haven_frostwood_events.line: You are about to volunteer for something. Breathe first.
event:haven_frostwood_events.reply: I was going to say something witty.

quest:quest_firemoss_cache_run.speaker: haven_mitia
quest:quest_firemoss_cache_run.line: Firemoss survives by staying small until the right moment.
